definitions.explanation: Allowing some light to pass through but not fully transparent. Objects behind a translucent material can be vaguely seen but not clearly.

examples.japanese: {半透明|はんとうめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{半透明|はんとうめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかく→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To soften the light with translucent curtains.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半透明|はんとうめい}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うっすら→うっすら：10236_ussura⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: This plastic container is translucent, so the contents are faintly visible.

notes:
{半透明|はんとうめい} describes something that lets some light through but is not fully see-through. Objects behind it appear blurry or indistinct.

FORMS:
⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half, semi-) + ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧ (transparent).
Used as both a noun and a な-adjective: {半透明|はんとうめい}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ (translucent material).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半透明|はんとうめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧: frosted/translucent glass
- {半透明|はんとうめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧: translucent film
- {半透明|はんとうめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧: translucent container
- {半透明|はんとうめい}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: translucent material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧: transparent (fully see-through)
- {半透明|はんとうめい}: translucent (partially see-through)
- ⟦{不透明|ふとうめい}→不透明：11365_futoumei⟧: opaque (not see-through); also figuratively means "unclear, uncertain"
